The test image shows a tomato leaf on a gray background with small, scattered dark brown spots across an otherwise green leaf. No concentric rings, no yellowing halos, no white powder, no webbing visible.

Comparing with the Bacterial_Spot reference: the bottom-left panel shows a nearly identical presentation — a mostly green leaf on a similar gray background with small dark spots. The KB description matches: "leaf lesions are initially circular and water-soaked... dark brown to black... rarely exceed 3mm."

The spots are too small and discrete for Early_Blight (which has concentric rings), and there's no stippling webbing pattern expected from Spider_Mites.
